name: Lakshya Powertech Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2012, Lakshya Powertech Ltd provides Engineering, Procurement, Consultancy services, and Integrated 
O&M Solutions[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
LPL is an ISO 9001:2018 and OHSAS 45001:2018 certified company providing tailored EPC services for oil & gas, industrial, power generation, and renewable energy sectors globally. It also offers integrated operations & management services, along with specialized solutions such as testing & commissioning, overhauls, and refurbishing/retrofitting.

pros: Stock is trading at 1.19 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 38.9%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has high debtors of 153 days.
Working capital days have increased from 107 days to 194 days
